text:
Predicates:
PublishingHouse(x) ::: x is a publishing house.
SpecializesIn(x, y) ::: x specializes in y.
PublishedBy(x, y) ::: book x is published by y.
Book(x) ::: x is a book.
InLanguage(x, y) ::: x is in language y.
TranslatedFrom(x, y) ::: x is translated from language y.
English ::: the English language.
Italian ::: the Italian language.
NewVesselPress ::: the publishing house New Vessel Press.
NeapolitanChronicles ::: the book Neapolitan Chronicles.
PalaceOfFlies ::: the book Palace of Flies.

Premises:
SpecializesIn(NewVesselPress, translatingForeignLiteratureIntoEnglish) ::: New Vessel Press is a publishing house which specializes in translating foreign literature into English.
∀x (PublishedBy(x, NewVesselPress) → InLanguage(x, English)) ::: All of New Vessel Press's published books are in English.
PublishedBy(NeapolitanChronicles, NewVesselPress) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is a book published by New Vessel Press.
TranslatedFrom(NeapolitanChronicles, Italian) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles was translated from Italian.
PublishedBy(PalaceOfFlies, NewVesselPress) ::: Palace of Flies is a book published by New Vessel Press.

Conclusion:
InLanguage(NeapolitanChronicles, English) ::: Neapolitan Chronicles is an English book.
